text:
Maya: Heads-up — small change for today's all-hands. Legal needs the first 10 mins for compliance notes, so we're moving the Roadmap Q&A to follow the leadership updates. Also, quick check: the dress rehearsal showed intermittent frame drops and captions lag.
Devon: OK with the swap. Can we confirm total runtime shift so presenters know?
Maya: Roadmap Q&A moves ~20 minutes later. I'll ping presenters to adjust.
Priya: On the recording side, OBS reported encoder spikes when other apps used the same GPU. Recommend reserving the GPU for the stream process only.
Samir: I can isolate the encoder process to the high-priority GPU on the meeting host machine. If we see >4% dropped frames over a rolling 30s window, we flip to the backup local recorder.
Lina: Accessibility note: please pre-start captioning. Last time participants complained captions started 45s late. Can ops pre-warm and confirm ready status 1 min before go?
ops-bot: preflight: captions_service=idle, encoder_temp=68C, local_rec_available=true, last_dropped_frames=2
Maya: @ops-bot, run prewarm for STT and post a ready signal. Also add a visible slide at the start that mentions possible 1-min caption delay.
deploy-bot: queued: \n```
/start-captions --model realtime-v2 --session allhands-1918012345 --timeout 40s
```
Command started.
Samir: I'm kicking the GPU isolation now: `taskset -c 6-7 /usr/bin/obs` and starting the watcher: `monitor-encoder --pid 4821 --threshold 4 --window 30s`.
ops-bot: captions_warmup=running, expected_ready_in=25s
Devon: I'll update the agenda slide deck and add a one-line caption status indicator.
Priya: For redundancy, start a local file capture to the meeting host: `/usr/local/bin/recwrap --device \"Blackmagic\" --outfile /recordings/allhands_1918012345.mkv --markers enabled`
Samir: Good. If local recorder starts we also add markers at 00:00, at Legal->Roadmap handoff, and at end. That way post-prod can stitch quickly.
Lina: I'll be in the lobby channel to handle attendee Qs and surface anything urgent to the hosts.
Maya: ACTIONS: Samir to isolate GPU and monitor + flip if needed; ops-bot to confirm captions warm; Devon to patch slide; Priya to start local capture; Lina handle lobby comms. Gabe, can you take notes and capture follow-ups?
Devon: Notes: updated slide + caption blurb added.
Samir: captions ready check: `/api/captions/status?session=allhands-1918012345` -> READY. Also local recorder started: `/recordings/allhands_1918012345.mkv`
ops-bot: captions_service=ready, timestamp=1918012560
Priya: Local recorder health: disk=OK, write_speed=220MB/s, file=/recordings/allhands_1918012345.mkv
Maya: Perfect. If anything degrades use this thread to call the contingency. We'll do a 30s pause if we need to switch recordings. Everyone on standby 5m before start.
Lina: :thumbsup: I'll announce the caption status in the lobby 1 min before start.
Devon: One last ask — can we auto-generate a rough VTT after upload for quick search? Samir, can you trigger that in the upload flow?
Samir: Yes. Upload + auto-transcribe on finalize: `s3-upload --file /recordings/allhands_1918012345.mkv --bucket redwood-allhands && transcribe-auto --s3 s3://redwood-allhands/allhands_1918012345.mkv --lang en`
Maya: Thanks team. See you in the room. If anything pops, post here and @everyone in the lobby channel.
